data.name: Nasiim
data.gender_notes: Nasiim is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nasiim is derived from the Arabic word nasa'ah, which means 'to breathe' or 'to send forth'. In Islamic tradition, the gentle wind (nasiim) is seen as a blessing from Allah SWT, symbolizing peace, tranquility, and the gift of life. It is also mentioned in the Quran (Surah Al-An'am, 6:97). The name Nasiim carries the meaning “Gentle Wind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nasiim usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle wind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of Allah's gentle mercy and blessings.
data.etymology: Nasiim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle Wind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nasiim total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
